query.text: The board was reluctant to sign off on the merger, citing unresolved regulatory questions on both sides of the Atlantic.

payload.translation: Dewan direksi enggan menyetujui merger itu, dengan alasan pertanyaan regulasi yang belum tuntas di kedua sisi Atlantik.

explanation.note: phrasal verb, to give formal approval. Stiffer than approve; standard in business writing.
menyebut sebagai alasan. Fronts the reason rather than stating it plainly.

explanation.term: on both sides of the Atlantic
explanation.note: idiom: in both the US and Europe, i.e. two separate regulators.

payload.notes: Business register. Board here is the board of directors.
